tools.name: find_ship
tools.description: Finds a Star Citizen ship or vehicle by any name or spelling and returns Open Hangar's name for it, its id, maker, role, size, and Store Price. Use it first when a pilot names a ship.

tools.name: ship_details
tools.description: One ship's facts: RSI's specs (career, role, size, crew, dimensions, and the stats its role needs), today's prices in RSI's store, and how often RSI sells it.

tools.name: compare_ships
tools.description: Two to four ships side by side, with a focus: general, cargo, combat, or racing. Price per SCU shows only for cargo ships with the cargo focus.

tools.name: ships_for_role
tools.description: Ships that fill a role (cargo, mining, salvage, medical, exploration, combat, and more), cheapest first, with filters for price, size, crew, and Flight Ready. Up to 25 ships.

tools.name: ship_rarity
tools.description: A ship's or item's rarity tier, with its reason and sources, only when Open Hangar's research proves it. No tier means it isn't proven rare.

tools.name: sale_history
tools.description: When RSI has sold a ship since November 2021: each sale window with its price and whether it was a warbond, how often it sells, and its usual price.

tools.name: store_now
tools.description: What RSI's pledge store sells right now, cheapest first, with what stands out about each (Warbond, Discounted, Limited, or Just Listed). Filter by type (ships, upgrades, or paints), warbond, or limited.

tools.name: upgrade_price
tools.description: The price of one upgrade (CCU) from one ship to another: the standard price, and the warbond price when RSI's store has one now. One step only.

tools.name: sale_calendar
tools.description: Announced dates, the yearly events and the months they usually fall in, and the days RSI's big sale events ran in past years. The months are estimates.
